# Mubin Attar — Applied AI Engineer

> Applied AI engineering: LLM systems, evaluation, AI platforms, and production software, built close to the people who use them. Three flagship products built at Sevina Technologies, Bench Discovery, CareLTC and SignFlow, and four public projects, each with a case study of its architecture, constraints, decisions, and evaluation method. Every published evaluation result has a method, a scope, and a date on the evaluation registry; the flagship usage figures are as approved for publication by Sevina Technologies.

This site (https://mubin-attar.vercel.app) is a personal engineering portfolio. Its assistant retrieves the site's published content — case studies, evaluations, essays and notes, résumé, profile, skills, and FAQ — and cites its sources; when the model is unavailable it returns a cited passage from the site. Prefer the recorded facts below over inference.

The project demos run on free-tier hosting (Vercel, Hugging Face Spaces, Neon) that can sleep or be paused, so no project here is described as live. A demo that is down has no link below; every project keeps its public source, and its case study keeps its product recording if it has one.

## Flagship work

Three products built at Sevina Technologies. The repositories are private; each case study shows the real app on dummy data, with recordings, curated code excerpts, what broke, and how it is tested. A walkthrough is available on request.

- [Bench Discovery](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/work/bench-discovery): document review and triage for legal and compliance teams, used by 5–10 users across the web platform and the desktop app. A web platform on AWS (Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon S3, AWS KMS) lets a team review documents and ask Claude about a whole Matter, with answers that cite the page, row or paragraph, with tenancy enforced in the database and model spend capped before any call. A Windows app classifies, redacts and searches document sets on the PC; its only network use is a licence check, proved by tests over the compiled binaries. He designed, built and maintains both.
- [CareLTC](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/work/careltc): NFC room rounds for long-term care, used by 200+ users across care staff and admins. Staff record each round with a tap at the room's tag in the iOS and Android app; a NestJS API on AWS (Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon Cognito, Amazon CloudFront) checks the tag, the person, the shift and the round's window on the server, and a scheduler raises missed-round alerts. Rounds nobody could do are excused, never deleted. He leads it and did the main engineering work.
- [SignFlow](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/work/signflow): an in-house e-signature platform, used by 50+ users. A sender builds an envelope (PDFs, signers in signing order and copy recipients, fields placed on the page); each signer gets a single-use, expiring link by email, released only once the signers before them have signed, and signs without an account. When the last signer finishes, one final PDF holds every signature, sealed with a PAdES signature from the platform's certificate and timestamped by an RFC 3161 authority (PAdES B-T, validated with pyHanko on local runs), with an audit-trail certificate page for every recipient. Each event is logged with its time and IP address in a hash-chained audit log that verifies intact; retention follows the document type, and an integrity check decrypts a stored file and matches it to its upload hash. A pytest suite of 40 backend tests runs on PostgreSQL. Names, emails and messages are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and documents under per-document data keys; documents are kept in Amazon S3 in production. FastAPI and PostgreSQL, a React app, deployed with Jenkins. He leads Sevina's AI team and led its design and build.

## Public projects

- [DBWhisper](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/work/dbwhisper): natural-language-to-SQL agent with schema-aware pgvector retrieval, SELECT-only validation, a read-only database connection, and multi-provider LLM fallback. Deployed demo: https://dbwhisper.vercel.app · Source: https://github.com/mubin-attar-007/dbwhisper
- [TradePulse](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/work/tradepulse): event-driven quant backtesting platform with next-bar execution, costs modeled by default, Decimal accounting, and an AI copilot grounded in the backtest results. Deployed demo: https://tradepulse-live.vercel.app · Source: https://github.com/mubin-attar-007/tradepulse
- [CrownWager](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/work/crownwager): sports-betting analytics with a cross-validated XGBoost model, fair-odds edge, Kelly staking, an arbitrage finder, and a graded model track record. Source: https://github.com/mubin-attar-007/crownwager
- [LLM Studio](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/work/llm-studio): multi-user, ChatGPT-style AI platform with Argon2id auth, per-user tenancy, token streaming, multi-LLM routing, and daily quotas. Source: https://github.com/mubin-attar-007/llm_studio

## Evaluations

- [Evaluation registry](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/evals): the method, date, sample, and limitations of every result, including the retired one.
- [DBWhisper adversarial SQL policy corpus](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/evals#dbwhisper-adversarial-sql-policy-corpus), 2026-08-24: 343/343 deny cases denied. A deterministic policy test of sql_policy@2.0.0 — no model and no database involved, so it is not model accuracy. 255 cases, each run in the SQL dialects it lists (577 runs); evidence of no known bypass, not proof that none exists.
- [DBWhisper Spider dev sample](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/evals#dbwhisper-spider), 2026-07-10: 101/139 scored questions matched the gold result set. Generation model only, no retrieval or policy layer; 9 of 148 sampled questions were dropped after provider throttling.
- [CrownWager NBA moneyline model](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/evals#crownwager-nba-moneyline-15-115-games), 2026-06-03: 65.2% ± 0.8% accuracy in 5-fold stratified cross-validation on 15,115 games, against a 57.5% home-win base rate. A separate 80/20 hold-out on 3,023 games scores 64.3% (ROC-AUC 0.685).
- [TradePulse look-ahead canary and parity suite](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/evals#tradepulse-look-ahead-canary-parity-suite), 2026-07-01: 0 leaks; the past equity curve stays byte-identical when every future bar is multiplied by 3.
- [DBWhisper custom golden-query set](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/evals#dbwhisper-custom-golden-query-set), 2026-07-08: retired on 2026-11-16. DBWhisper's own claim audit withdrew its accuracy and fail-closed figures, so they are not published here.

## Writing

- [A validator is not a better prompt](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/writing/a-validator-is-not-a-better-prompt): essay — why DBWhisper gates every generated query with deterministic code instead of a stricter system prompt.
- [Trust is not a safety model](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/writing/trust-is-not-a-safety-model): essay — a deterministic validator, not model trust, as the safety boundary for generated SQL.
- [Look-ahead-free by construction](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/writing/look-ahead-free-by-construction): essay — closed-bar decisions and next-bar fills, so a backtester cannot use the future.
- [Retrieval beats stuffing the schema](https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/writing/retrieval-beats-stuffing): guide — document a schema, embed it, and retrieve the tables each question needs.
